","source":"export function slugify(value: string): string {
  const lower = value.toLowerCase();
  // Replace all non-alphanumeric characters with a space
  const normalized = lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ');
  // Split by whitespace, filter empty strings, join with hyphens
  return normalized.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).join('-');
}"}

- Preserves digits
- Returns empty string for punctuation-only input
